about: The devtools panel's size ledger (plan phase 3; studio/README.md, 'The size ledger'). Append-only: an item that lands appends one row — its label, the budget item it counts against ("" for none) and panel.js's gzip bytes after it — and never edits an earlier one. scripts/panel-budget.ts prints the per-item table from it on every build; only the cap fails the build. Sizes are measured with the version stamp normalized: the stamped version string (scripts/weft-version.ts, JSON-quoted) is replaced by the fixed-length placeholder "v0.00.0" (normalizeStamp) before gzip, in the build and in budget.test.ts alike, so a version bump moves no byte; the rows before this normalization read the same under it.
measure: The rows through "verification fixes" (62,734 B) were measured with node:zlib's gzipSync under the host Node, whose zlib differs across Node versions (the CI runner read the same bundle as 62,590 B). From the next row on, sizes are measured with gzipSize (scripts/panel-budget.ts): pako's pure-JS port of zlib's deflate at level 6, pinned by the lockfile, the same bytes on any host. Earlier rows stay as recorded.

items.accepted: review-driven honesty (derived records, the manifest re-asked, the unreachable child, not_served); nothing deferrable at first paint; the minify lever in reserve
the verbs and the ack preview are the item; nothing deferrable is more than 0.3 KiB; 14 KiB of headroom with the minify lever in reserve
nothing deferrable supplies the first scope; the deferrable remainder is under 1 KiB
the host API is one surface for both installs; nothing to load later

review-driven honesty and correctness: the compacted-range pre-check in F1.1's words, the pending/held Run states, steers by step, the int64/2^53 refusals, the fork hold; nothing deferrable supplies the editor's first paint; 2.2 KiB of headroom remain
